title: CSV Imports
subtitle: Import customers or bookings from CSV exports. Every import is dry-run first so you can see which rows would fail.
services_subtitle: The Calendar column contains service names. Map each to an existing service or create a new one.
email_note: Customers with a confirmed booking will receive a confirmation email. Email sending is controlled by the server's EMAIL_SENDING flag.
emails_note: {{count}} confirmation emails queued (sending depends on the server's EMAIL_SENDING flag)
emails_disabled: Email sending is disabled on the server (EMAIL_SENDING=false) — no confirmation emails were queued.
fix_rows_hint: Fix the failing rows in the source file and upload again, or import only the valid rows.
